_why: Profiles are DECLARED, never discovered by scanning a directory.
A profile is an IDENTITY. A surface is a probe. Decided 2026-08-31 after one
jar was measured holding LinkedIn, Reddit, Google and YouTube at once, which
is the shared-computer shape the Grok Bot research rejected, arriving from
the other direction. The plan's isolation constraint only ever separated
research from the real Chrome, never research profiles from each other.
Splitting this jar needs the founder's sign-ins, so it is captured as
spillover rather than done here; expected_cookie_hosts makes the drift
visible in the meantime.
logged_in_marker must be measured ABSENT on a signed-out load before it is
declared. A marker that is PRESENT while signed out reports alive forever,
and alive is silent, which is the worst failure available here. Measured
2026-08-31 against a throwaway signed-out profile:
myaccount.google.com  'SignOutOptions' absent, 'Sign out' PRESENT (rejected)
www.youtube.com       'SignOutOptions' absent, 'avatar'   PRESENT (rejected)
news.ycombinator.com  'logout'         absent, 'login'    present
A marker never yet seen TRUE reports state 'unverified', never 'dead', so a
wrong guess cannot page the founder with a false death.
unmonitored_surfaces are sessions this jar holds that are deliberately NOT
probed. They stay on the receipt and print on every run, because the blind
spot that started all of this was invisible, not accepted.

profiles.name: research-hn
profiles.identity: the founder's own identity, currently sharing one jar across several surfaces
profiles.purpose: Reference profile for the persistent-browsing capability. Continuity monitoring for the sessions this jar holds.

unmonitored_surfaces.reason: FORBIDDEN, and separately FOUNDER-DECLINED 2026-08-31 ("dont watch linkedin or reddit"). The refusal stands on its own: canon 2026-07-17 (reddit_driver.py) is that a Playwright-driven Reddit session is WAF-blocked, and this capability being headful and read-only is a real but UNMEASURED difference. Reddit actions go through the Chrome extension, not through this. Enforced at load by FORBIDDEN_PROBE_HOSTS; declining to watch is not permission to probe.

FOUNDER-DECLINED 2026-08-31, verbatim: "no. dont watch linkedin or reddit." He does not want continuity monitoring on this surface; he wants an ACTION path to it. Declining to watch is not permission to probe, so nothing here probes it.
